description: This file defines the Shipping controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, handling shipping address input, validation, quote retrieval, and saving shipping method selections during checkout.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class managing shipping address, quote, and method selection during checkout.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping information form if shipping is enabled and applicable.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Validates shipping address data, retrieves available shipping methods, and returns them as JSON.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the selected shipping method into session data after validation.
